store.summary: Live camera feed as ASCII art in the terminal, with colour and edge modes
store.description: AsciiCam renders the camera feed as ASCII art in any terminal — on the device LCD console or over SSH — and the character grid follows the terminal size. Cycle through four character ramps, toggle truecolour, edge detection, flipping and inversion, tune gamma with [ and ], and save any frame to a text file with s. Works with the built-in CSI camera via picamera2, any V4L2/USB webcam via OpenCV, or a synthetic test pattern when no camera is available (--source test).
